'''North Kallis''' was one of three smallish continents that shared a seasonal cycle and were located in the southern hemisphere of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. The undeveloped areas of the continent were covered in thick [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of [[Corulag bamboo]] that were impenetrable except on foot or in specialized bulldozer craft designed to cut down the [[Plant/Legends|bamboo]]. A few enclaves of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] thrived on North Kallis in contrast to Corulag's primarily [[Human/Legends|Human]] population.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
North Kallis was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
